original_method: Verify exact code/SUT/recipe identity, preserve logs, capture complete raw/decoded Type 38, compare all fields and raw bit encodings to this target's matrix, perform one approved reboot, repeat and retain separate evidence from the row-1942 testcase.
manual_activity: The owner supplies this exact target's Type 38 matrix and approves reboot/recovery; the operator verifies target identity and workload safety.

Policy distinguishing this row from Wistron-BIOS-00466-V003 evidence
Approved reboot, boot deadline, workload window and independent recovery
safety_requirements: Reject evidence from the similar code/row or any unverified host
Preserve logs and keep SMBIOS/IPMI reads non-mutating
Do not change BMC/IPMI interface settings to match the matrix
Use verified host identity and protected credentials
Require reboot approval and stop on target drift or recovery failure
No automatic retry or inferred reuse of prior results
agent_execution_scope: Verify exact code/target/recipe and approved matrix
Collect full raw/decoded Type 38 before/after approved reboot
Validate fields and bit encodings while keeping evidence separate from row 1942
Make no configuration change, retry or PASS/FAIL verdict

Approve reboot/recovery and protected evidence policy

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind raw captures to exact code, platform serial/recipe and firmware identity, decode complete Type 38 bitfields and compare only this row's matrix across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact target isolation and complete bitfield/persistence evidence without log or IPMI mutation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Reusing a similar row can conceal valid platform-specific address/interface differences; a header filter cannot show any of them.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Whether two Type 38 rows are expected to match is a recipe decision, not inferable from their common title or command.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: This row's Items, Procedure and Criteria coherently target Type 38. Similar row 1942 is a distinct identity, not a contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Exact-target matrix and reboot approval are normal inputs; execution is gated but static review is complete.

review_improvement: Adds explicit exact-target isolation so a similar Type 38 testcase cannot be used as a surrogate, while retaining complete field and reboot coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: Two rows can share a Type 38 title yet legitimately describe different IPMI host-interface implementations or base addresses. Therefore even byte-identical expected matrices do not make their execution evidence interchangeable: target identity is part of the claim. This case must bind both captures to Wistron-BIOS-00487-V002 and compare its own raw modifier/interrupt bytes, otherwise a plausible result from row 1942 could falsely satisfy it.
